name: Ruy López — Exchange Variation
description: The Exchange Variation — White gives up the bishop pair with 4.Bxc6, saddling Black with doubled c-pawns. After 5.O-O f6 6.d4 exd4 7.Nxd4 c5, the position is structurally imbalanced: White has a mobile pawn center; Black has the bishop pair and fighting chances. A positional endgame battle.

lines.name: Exchange Variation — Main Line
lines.description: White plays 4.Bxc6 immediately, doubling Black's c-pawns. After 5.O-O f6 6.d4 exd4, White recaptures 7.Nxd4 and Black gains space with 7...c5, attacking the knight. White retreats 8.Nb3 — the natural square — and Black forces the queen trade with 8...Qxd1. White recaptures 9.Rxd1, reaching the famous Exchange endgame, and Black develops 9...Bd6 with the bishop pair as compensation.
